story.originalTitle: Who slept best last night: Toto Wolff
story.summaryEn: On Sunday evening in Sao Paulo, Toto Wolff needed no bragging when asked about his records, having matched Frank Williams' tally of constructors' championships and Ron Dennis' overall number of titles.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯老板沃尔夫拥有九个车队冠军
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
在圣保罗周日晚间被问及自己的纪录时，托托·沃尔夫无需自夸，这些纪录如今让他与F1两位伟人比肩。仅是被问到追平弗兰克·威廉姆斯的车队冠军数和罗恩·丹尼斯的总体冠军数感受如何，就足以说明沃尔夫成就的分量。
他现有九个车队冠军，与威廉姆斯持平，总体冠军数为17个，与丹尼斯持平。
“当我想到这一点时，这两位是这项运动的巨人，”他说。“我甚至不在弗兰克所在的同一星系里，他在事故之后仍然能够取得伟大成就。同样，罗恩是一个你总是仰望的人，他是这项运动的标杆，设定了新的标准。”
他补充道：“我永远不会把自己看作那个级别的人。”
自从那两位赢得冠军并试图击败彼此的时代以来，一级方程式已经发生了巨大变化。这也许过于简化，但如今更重要的是经营一门高效的生意，而不是经营最好的车库。他们同样必须确保赞助协议并吸引最优秀的人才，但现代F1的运营，尤其是一支拥有自己引擎部门的厂商车队，要复杂许多倍。员工人数的巨大差异令人震惊。
沃尔夫没有机会认识为他车队工作的每一个人，也无法依赖那种在1980年代或许仍然可能的微观管理。这需要不同的技能组合，需要对所谓的“文化”有更清晰的理解，并且在构建一个组织时要有更高的精确度，在这个组织中，授权不仅是一种工具，而且是一种必需。
但丹尼斯和威廉姆斯两人的共同之处在于，他们并非只是在车队表现的巅峰、一切条件都契合时连续夺冠。他们反复做到这一点，重建自己所领导的团队，然后再次回归并夺冠。威廉姆斯在与本田分手后做到了这一点，凭借雷诺重返巅峰。丹尼斯则在阿兰·普罗斯特和艾尔顿·塞纳时代之后做到了这一点，重建迈凯伦，与米卡·哈基宁和梅赛德斯一起赢得三个冠军。
沃尔夫大概说得没错，从某种意义上说，他从未需要应对涉及主要合作伙伴或引擎制造商变更的彻底重组。但2026赛季最终证明，他也并非只能成功一次的人。
梅赛德斯并没有跌到谷底。但在如此轻松且持续地获胜之后，车队可能变得过于固守旧法，难以改变和适应。2022年的新规则周期是一场压力测试，它未能通过——而在追赶方面，旧方法已不再奏效。
我们永远不会确切知道沃尔夫做了什么，或者哪些流程需要改变。我们只能根据结果来判断。而2026年证实了他做了必须做的事。
“回头看，我觉得那最后四年非常艰难，”他在周日说道。“在犯错、然后有点明白为什么错、接着意识到不，我们没搞懂之间……那是一个很大的反复。”
“但我们在10年或20年后回看，当你看看统计数据，那四年我们并不是彻底的失败者，因为我们拿了第二、第三、第三、第四——我想那大概就是当时的结果。我们赢过比赛，赢过很多比赛。所以单看数字，那根本不差，但感觉并不好。”
“而车队的韧性，那些在艰难时期团结在一起的人，是一个因素，我认为。所以锁定这两个冠军感觉真的很好。”
“没有多少运动队能在连续夺冠、然后经历一段艰难时期、再重新回来之后做到这一点。所以我真的很自豪，我们属于在所有体育项目中做到这一点的极少数车队之一。”
即便他目前还不在同一水平线上，他也无疑是F1历史上最优秀的车队领队之一。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
文化这个词常被管理者使用和滥用，其中许多人并不真正理解它的含义。但这不仅仅是原则和规则的问题。它关乎选择一个共同目标，建立正确的流程，找到最优秀的人并帮助他们实现抱负——并为此全力以赴。
有很多人声称要建设“一种文化”。真正理解自己所指为何的人却少得多。
“我们不是一个随意招聘和解雇的组织，”沃尔夫说。“我们提供一种文化与环境，让你能够茁壮成长，允许你犯错，允许你直言不讳。从长远来看，我相信，如果你想取得成功——不是几年内的成功，而是几十年间的成功——这就是你需要能够根植于团队的东西。”
“我们正在努力这样做。这不是你能放在幻灯片上的东西。你必须日复一日地提升自己的标准。而这些就是我们为自己设定的标准。有时我们会失败，但我们着眼于长期愿景。”
同样，只看到冰山一角不足以准确判断这其中有多少是沃尔夫的功劳。但这种帮助人们茁壮成长的文化——这也意味着支持那些正在挣扎的人——是显而易见的。
沃尔夫处理乔治·拉塞尔的方式，或许也是梅赛德斯F1车队中周日唯一不完全满意的人，同样是管理人才的教科书式范例。
对拉塞尔来说，这一年无疑很艰难。但沃尔夫始终把手搭在他肩上，从不让外界有任何理由怀疑自己仍然信任他——尽管有些人认为沃尔夫只关心安东内利。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
“今天属于乔治的冠军，”托托说。“这是车队冠军，而他是车队的一部分，我真的很高兴他能珍惜这一刻，因为我们欠他的。”
他还补充道：“我对明年毫无疑问，所有最优秀的体育人都经历过困难时期，这将是他持续成长的一部分。”
听听乔治自己怎么说。他的圣保罗周末或许完美诠释了他的2026赛季。速度的闪光，但不受他控制的环境因素阻止他取得成绩——就像周六发生的那样——以及他自己的一些失误，比如周日维修区出口的那次。
但他谈论沃尔夫的方式几乎让人毫不怀疑他也感受到了那份信任。
周六，当2026赛季以错失杆位的形式再次给他打击时，他谈论更多的仍是更大的图景而非事件本身：“我认为托托领导力中我很钦佩的一点是，我们今天拥有的人，正是那些辉煌岁月里就在的人，也正是那些经历了2022到2025年困难时期的人。
“没有人被聘用又被解雇。信任和信念始终与核心团队同在，而且，你知道，现在我们挺过来了。而且，你知道，显然，基米赢得了冠军。我们会赢得冠军，无论是这个周末还是下一个。而且，你知道，要归功于团队中的每一个人，但是的，托托对人们的忠诚和信念，即使在艰难时期也如此，这要大大归功于他。”
这种忠诚与信任，正是沃尔夫此刻向拉塞尔展示的。而拉塞尔的职业生涯仍可能走上两条截然不同的道路：一条是尼科·罗斯伯格的路，另一条是丹尼尔·里卡多的路。
里卡多当年觉得，当他认为车队把所有希望都押在马克斯·维斯塔潘身上时，自己除了离开红牛别无选择。但在沃尔夫执掌梅赛德斯的情况下，拉塞尔仍然知道自己有机会实现目标——这要归功于他的老板在车队中建立的文化。
因为这是一种允许人们学习、重建并再次获胜的文化。
此外也没有太多可补充的了。数据本身就说明了一切。
向托托·沃尔夫致敬。那件事处理得很好。
detailEn: Nine constructors' titles for the Mercedes boss
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

Toto Wolff didn't need to brag when, on Sunday evening in Sao Paulo, he was asked about his records, which now put him alongside two of F1's greats. The question of how it feels to match Frank Williams' tally of constructors' championships and Ron Dennis' overall number of titles was enough in itself to illustrate the magnitude of Wolff's achievements.
He now has nine constructors' titles, level with Williams, and 17 titles overall, matching Dennis.

"When I think about it, these two are giants of the sport," he said. "I'm not even operating in the same galaxy as Frank, who after his accident, has been able to achieve great things. And in the same way, Ron is a person that [you] always look up to who has been the benchmark in the sport, who has set new standards."
He added: "I will never see myself in that league."

Formula 1 has changed enormously since the days when those two were winning titles and trying to beat each other. It might be an oversimplification, but nowadays it's much more about running an efficient business than running the best garage. They, too, had to secure sponsorship deals and attract the best talent, but modern F1 operations, especially a works team with its own engine department, are many times more complex. The sheer difference in employee numbers is staggering.

Wolff has no chance of knowing everyone working for his team and can't rely on the kind of micromanagement that was perhaps still possible in the 1980s. It requires a different skill set, a much clearer understanding of what's called "culture", and far greater precision in building an organisation in which delegation is not just a tool, but a necessity.

But what Dennis and Williams have in common is that they didn't just win titles in succession, at the peak of their teams' performance, when everything aligned. They did it repeatedly, rebuilding the organisations they led to come back and win again. Williams did it after splitting with Honda, returning to the top with Renault. Dennis did it after the Alain Prost and Ayrton Senna era, rebuilding McLaren to win three titles with Mika Hakkinen and Mercedes.

Wolff is probably right in the sense that he has never had to deal with a complete reorganisation involving a change of major partners or engine manufacturer. But the 2026 season is the ultimate proof that he, too, is not someone who can only do it once.

Mercedes didn't hit rock bottom. But after winning so easily and so consistently, the team may have become too set in its ways to change and adapt. The new regulation cycle in 2022 was a stress test it failed – and the old methods were no longer working when it came to catching up.
We'll never know exactly what Wolff did or which processes needed to change. We can only judge by the results. And 2026 is confirmation that he did what was required.

"Looking back, I think those last four years were very difficult," he said on Sunday. "Between getting it wrong and then kind of understanding why it was wrong and then realising, no, we didn't understand... And that was a big back and forth.

"But we will be looking back in 10 or 20 years, and when you look at the statistics, it wasn't that we were complete losers over those four years, because we finished second, third, third, fourth - I think that was maybe what the results were. We won races, won many races. So it wasn't that bad at all when you look at the sheer numbers, but it felt not good.
"And the resilience of the team, the people that held together in those tough times is a factor, I think. So it feels really good sealing those two titles.

"Not many sports teams have done that after a consecutive run of championships, then a difficult spell, and then coming back. So I'm really proud that we are part of this very small group of teams that have done that in all sports."
Even if he isn't in quite the same league yet, he's certainly among the very best team bosses in F1 history.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

Culture is a word often used and abused by managers, many of whom don't really understand what it entails. But it's not just a matter of principles and rules. It's about choosing a common goal, putting the right processes in place, finding the best people and helping them fulfil their ambitions – and being committed to all of it.
There are plenty of people who say they want to build "a culture". Far fewer actually understand what they mean by that.

"We are not a hire-and-fire organisation," Wolff says. "We provide a culture and an environment where you can thrive, where you are allowed to make mistakes, where you can speak up. And over the long term, I believe, if you want to be successful, not over a period of a few years but over many decades, this is what you need to be able to kind of ingrain in the team.

"And we are trying that. It's not something you put on a PowerPoint. You have to lift your standards day in and day out. And these are the standards we are setting to ourselves. Sometimes we fail, but we look at the long-term vision."

Again, seeing only the tip of the iceberg isn't enough to judge exactly how much of this is Wolff's doing. But that culture of helping people thrive – which also means supporting those who are struggling – is on display.
The way Wolff handles George Russell, probably the only member of the Mercedes F1 team who wasn't entirely happy on Sunday, is a textbook example of managing talent, too.

It's been a tough year for Russell, no doubt about that. But Wolff keeps an arm around his shoulder and never gives the outside world any reason to doubt that he still believes in him – even though some suggest he only cares about Antonelli.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
"It's George's championship today," Toto said. "It's the constructors' championship, and he's part of the team, and I'm really happy that he can cherish this moment, because we owe it to him."
And he added: "I have no doubt about that for next year, and all the very best sports people have gone through difficult periods, and that's going to be part of his continued development."

And listen to George himself. His Sao Paulo weekend was perhaps a perfect illustration of his 2026 season. Flashes of speed, but circumstances beyond his control preventing him from getting the result – as happened on Saturday – and some mistakes of his own, as at the pit exit on Sunday.
But the way he speaks about Wolff leaves little doubt that he feels that trust, too.

On Saturday, when 2026 dealt him another blow in the form of a missed pole position, he still spoke more about the bigger picture than the incident itself: "I think something I admire a lot from Toto's leadership is the people we have today are the same people who were there during the glory years, and they're the same people who went through the difficulties during 2022 to 2025.

"Nobody was hired and fired. The trust and belief stayed with the core group of people, and, you know, now we've come through. And, you know, obviously, Kimi won the championship. We are going to win the championship, whether it's this weekend or next. And, you know, credit to everybody in the team, but yeah, huge credit to Toto for that loyalty and belief in the people, even when times were tough."
That loyalty and belief is exactly what Wolff is showing Russell right now. And Russell's career could still follow one of two very different paths: that of Nico Rosberg or that of Daniel Ricciardo.

Ricciardo felt he had little choice but to leave Red Bull when he believed the team was putting all its eggs in the Max Verstappen basket. But with Wolff leading Mercedes, Russell still knows he has a chance to achieve what he wants – thanks to the culture his boss has built at the team.
Because it's a culture that allows people to learn, rebuild and win again.
And there's not much more to add. The statistics really speak for themselves.
Hats off, Toto Wolff. That was well managed.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯技术总监警告，F1车队不会对2027年下压力削减坐视不管
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森警告，F1工程师将对国际汽联2027年的下压力削减予以反击
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
F1向2026年新动力单元与底盘规则的过渡彻底打乱了竞争格局，但规则手册远未最终确定。随着车队为2027年新规下的第二个赛季做准备，国际汽联正推动再次强制降低下压力。
早期报告表明，管理机构的目标是在2027赛季将下压力减少20至50个点。为了实现这一目标，国际汽联计划禁止若干关键的后部空气动力学部件，以改善混合动力能量管理，并减少阻碍赛车紧密跟车的湍流“脏空气”。
但梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森最近警告说，制定规则来减慢一级方程式赛车的速度，很少能阻止围场顶尖工程师找到绕过它的办法。
在NU Silver Arrows Radio Show播客节目中，艾利森确认了国际汽联拟议的空气动力学限制范围，同时向即将到来的研发战发出了挑战。
“我所知道的是，新规则会让赛车损失一些下压力，不止一点，”艾利森解释道。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯车队
从历史上看，国际汽联与一级方程式车队之间的关系始终是一场无休止的猫鼠游戏。管理机构出于安全和竞赛考量修改规则手册以限制过弯速度，而车队则立即在风洞中投入数百万美元，以恢复国际汽联试图削去的下压力。
据艾利森表示，2027年的规则周期也不会有任何不同。
“他们已经做出了不错的尝试，试图将下压力拉回到2026时代初期的水平，”艾利森指出。
他补充道：“看看各车队是会选择妥协接受，还是会全力夺回全部性能，这将非常有意思。”
如果梅赛德斯在2026年的巨大飞跃能说明什么，那就是阿利森在布拉克利的工程部门完全没有妥协的打算。2027赛季的技术战线已经正式划定。
detailEn: Mercedes technical director warns F1 teams won’t “lie down” over 2027 downforce cuts
Mercedes technical director James Allison warns F1 engineers will fight back against the FIA's 2027 downforce cuts
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Formula 1's transition to the new 2026 engine and chassis regulations completely reshuffled the competitive order, but the rulebook is far from finalised. As teams prepare for their second year under the new formula in 2027, the FIA is pushing to mandate another drop in downforce.

Early reports indicate the governing body is targeting a reduction of 20 to 50 points of downforce for the 2027 season. To achieve this, the FIA plans to ban several key rear aerodynamic elements in a bid to improve hybrid energy management and reduce the turbulent "dirty air" that prevents cars from following each other closely.
But Mercedes technical director James Allison recently cautioned that writing a rule to slow down a Formula 1 car rarely stops the grid's top engineers from finding a way around it.

Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show podcast, Allison confirmed the scope of the FIA's proposed aerodynamic restrictions while simultaneously throwing down the gauntlet for the upcoming development war.
"All I know is that the cars are going to be losing a bit of downforce from the new regs, more than a bit," Allison explained.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Historically, the relationship between the FIA and Formula 1 constructors is a perpetual game of cat and mouse. The governing body alters the rulebook to limit cornering speeds on safety and racing grounds, and the teams immediately spend millions of dollars in the wind tunnel to recover the exact downforce the FIA attempted to take away.
According to Allison, the 2027 regulation cycle will be no different.
"They've had a good go at trying to pull the downforce back to [the] start of the 2026 era," Allison noted.
"It'll be interesting to see whether the teams lie down and take that or whether we recover it all or not," he added.

If Mercedes' massive leap forward in 2026 is any indication, Allison's engineering department in Brackley has zero intention of lying down. The technical battle lines for the 2027 season have officially been drawn.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Mercedes and Audi unveil adidas collections for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
detailZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛上推出阿迪达斯系列
梅赛德斯-奔驰霓虹灯和奥迪夜场系列现已通过adidas.com购买
拉斯维加斯欢迎标志上空出现彩虹
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪为即将到来的Formula 1拉斯维加斯大奖赛推出了特别的阿迪达斯粉丝系列。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列名为"霓虹灯"，而奥迪的系列名为"深夜"。这两个系列现在已在adidas.com上上市，品牌美国店内的单品价格从30美元到200美元不等。
最贵的产品是外套。梅赛德斯-奔驰的拉斯维加斯夹克和奥迪的拉斯维加斯轰炸机夹克都售价200美元。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列比奥迪的大。除了夹克，它还包括120美元的卫衣、95美元的长袖T恤、60美元的短裤、55美元的车手帽、50美元的比赛帽和40美元及45美元的T恤。
奥迪车队的阵容有55美元的车手上限，两件各45美元的图形T恤和一件30美元的包。
两支车队抵达拉斯维加斯时的位置截然不同。梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛上锁定了2026年 constructors' championship。奥迪在接管萨博后作为一支工厂车队的第一赛季，目前排名第八，积28分。这家德国车队落后哈斯三分。
梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了车手冠军，成为F1历史上最年轻的冠军。他的队友乔治·拉塞尔目前正在争夺亚军，目前排名第三，落后红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和尼科·胡肯伯格目前在车手积分榜上分别排名第14和第15，两人都积14分。
拉斯维加斯大奖赛将于11月19日至21日举行，是赛季最后三轮比赛中的第一轮，紧接着是卡塔尔和阿布扎比。
detailEn: Mercedes and Audi unveil adidas collections for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
The Mercedes Neon Lights and Audi After Hours collections are available now through adidas.com
A rainbow above the Welcome to Las Vegas sign
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Mercedes and Audi have unveiled special adidas fan collections for the upcoming Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Mercedes' range is called "Neon Lights", while Audi's is named "After Hours". Both collections are available now through adidas.com, and the pieces listed on the brand's US store range in price from $30 to $200.
The most expensive items are the outerwear. Mercedes' Las Vegas jacket and Audi's Las Vegas bomber jacket both cost $200.
The Mercedes collection is the bigger of the two. Alongside the jacket, it includes a $120 hoodie, a $95 long-sleeve T-shirt, $60 shorts, a $55 driver cap, a $50 race cap and T-shirts at $40 and $45.
Audi's line-up has a $55 driver cap, two graphic T-shirts at $45 each and a $30 bag.

The two teams arrive in Las Vegas in very different positions. Mercedes secured the 2026 constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix. Audi, in its first season as a works team after taking over Sauber, currently sits eighth in the standings with 28 points. The German outfit is three points behind Haas.

Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed the drivers' title at the Mexican Grand Prix, becoming the youngest champion in the history of F1. His team-mate George Russell is currently in the fight for second in the championship, sitting third behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto and Nico Hulkenberg currently sit 14th and 15th in the drivers' standings, both on 14 points.
The Las Vegas Grand Prix takes place from 19 to 21 November and is the first of the final three rounds of the season, ahead of Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
relatedItems.summaryEn: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies, and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与荷兰技术集团VDK签任大使协议
这位红牛车手将在未来数年参与VDK的传播与营销活动
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘成为荷兰安装与技术企业集团VDK Group的新任大使，该集团正在向欧洲扩张。
这位荷兰车手将在未来几年在该公司的国际品牌推广中发挥重要作用，并将出现在其传播和营销活动中。
VDK 成立于 2013 年，是一家荷兰技术公司集团，如今在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时都有业务。
维斯塔潘表示，他认为 VDK 的组织方式与 F1 车队的运作方式有相似之处。
“VDK 的世界与一级方程式赛车之间有很多相似之处，”这位红牛车手说道。“技术发挥着巨大作用，但任何关注这项运动的人都知道，只有整个团队都达到顶尖水平，你才能发挥出最佳表现。”
在一支一级方程式车队里，每天都有大量的人在工作，让一切变得更好、更快。每个人都有自己的专业领域和职责。我在VDK的运作方式中看到了这一点。
它由许多技术公司和专业人士组成，他们各有专长，但团结在一起就更强大。VDK是一家创新型公司，也有着远大的国际雄心。我很高兴能在未来几年成为其中一员。
VDK创始人兼首席执行官弗兰斯·范德科尔克表示，这位荷兰人是公司下一步发展的理想人选。
“马克斯·维斯塔潘加入VDK集团让我无比自豪，”范德科尔克说。“马克斯多年来一直是世界上最顶尖的车手之一。但同样吸引我的是这背后的一切。仅靠天赋永远不够。你需要身边有优秀的人、相互信任、技术专长，以及每天变得更好的动力。这正是我在VDK集团所看到的。”
“我们通过整合实力雄厚的本地家族企业，并给予创业者自由发展的空间来实现增长。这一基础不会改变。与此同时，我们正日益将目光投向国门之外。”
“随着在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时拥有公司，我们正在形成一个日益国际化的集团。马克斯·维斯塔潘闻名世界，同时也体现了那种令人熟悉的荷兰务实态度和赢家心态。说实话，我无法想象还有谁比他更能代表我们希望带领VDK前进的方向。”
过去两年一直与VDK合作的前F1车手罗伯特·杜恩博斯将继续担任大使和演讲嘉宾。根据公告，他在协调与维斯塔潘的合作关系中发挥了关键作用。
“我非常高兴能与弗兰斯和VDK集团合作，”杜恩博斯解释道。“我们已经共同取得了伟大的成就，我也真正了解了VDK背后的人。如今我还能为这一下一步贡献力量，这让一切更加特别。”
“有了马克斯，VDK 集团当然就引进了一位真正独一档的人物。我很高兴我们现在为 VDK 集团携手合作，也非常期待未来的岁月。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
The Red Bull driver will feature in VDK’s communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies that is expanding across Europe.
The Dutchman will play a prominent role in the company's international branding over the coming years and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns.
VDK was founded in 2013 as a Dutch group of technical companies and now has businesses in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland and Belgium.
Verstappen said he saw parallels between the way VDK is organised and the way an F1 team works.

"There are many similarities between the world of VDK and Formula 1," the Red Bull driver said. "Technology plays a huge role, but anyone who follows the sport knows that you can only perform at your best if the entire team is top-notch.

"In a Formula 1 team, a huge number of people work every day to make everything better and faster. Everyone has their own area of specialisation and responsibility. I recognise that in the way VDK operates.

"It’s a group of many technical companies and professionals who all have their own expertise but are stronger together. VDK is an innovative company and also has major international ambitions. I’m excited to be a part of that in the coming years."
VDK founder and chief executive Frans van der Kolk said the Dutchman was the ideal fit for the company's next step.

"The fact that Max Verstappen is joining the VDK Group makes me incredibly proud," van der Kolk said. "Max has been among the absolute world’s best for years. But what appeals to me just as much is what lies behind that. Talent alone is never enough. You need good people around you, mutual trust, technical expertise, and the drive to get better every day. That’s exactly what I see in the VDK Group.

"We’ve grown by bringing together strong local and family-owned businesses and giving entrepreneurs the freedom to thrive. That foundation won’t change. At the same time, we’re looking beyond our borders with increasing focus.

"With companies in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland, and Belgium, we’re forming an increasingly international group. Max Verstappen is known worldwide and, at the same time, embodies that recognisable Dutch down-to-earth attitude and winner’s mentality. To be honest, I can’t imagine a stronger face to represent where we want to take VDK."

Former F1 driver Robert Doornbos, who has worked with VDK for the past two years, will stay on as an ambassador and speaker. According to the announcement, he played a key role in coordinating the partnership with Verstappen.

"I am very pleased with the collaboration with Frans and the VDK Group," Doornbos explained. "We’ve already achieved great things together, and I’ve really gotten to know the people behind VDK. The fact that I’ve now also been able to contribute to this next step makes it even more special.

"With Max, the VDK Group is, of course, bringing in someone who is truly in a league of his own. I’m happy that we’re now working together for the VDK Group and am really looking forward to the years ahead."
